steps.what: Establish student needs and agree Individualized Education Program goals with relevant participants
Write Individualized Education Programs from agreed decisions and verified evidence

loop.purpose: Express agreed educational decisions in the required program structure
loop.input: Teacher-confirmed goals, supports, evidence, responsibilities and review dates
loop.output: Draft program with source-linked statements and marked gaps
loop.check: Teacher checks every goal, support, baseline and statement of need against decisions and original evidence; no new diagnosis or placement conclusion is allowed
loop.stop: One revision; unsupported needs, changed goals or unclear attribution return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native fields organise decisions but cannot express all individual explanations

steps.what: Review the program with required participants and approve the teacher's final version

tasks.design: Configure native program records in {LMS} before adding a bounded {DOCS} drafting loop for agreed decisions. Keep needs assessment, participant discussion and final review human; the tool cannot decide support, placement or educational goals.
tasks.previous_blocker: Agreed individual decisions must be rewritten into a complete program document.
tasks.enabler_now: Native pupil records support goals and program information; a constrained draft can assist expression.
tasks.still_hard: A fluent draft can silently change a child's needs or the agreed support.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the student and build a workable program with the people involved.
tasks.altitude: Less document assembly, with educational decisions and consultation unchanged.

reach.learn: Individual goals, evidence and participant responsibilities

evidence.claim: ParnasSys supports pupil records, an OPP module and learning-goal tracking; this does not establish automated program decisions.
The proposed source-grounded drafting reduction is an unmeasured scenario; no individual-program result is established.

assumptions: Boundary is teacher program development and writing; family and specialist participation retain their own labour outside the denominator.

Teacher produces checked student id, source observations, agreed goals, supports, responsibility owners and review dates in s1's full45 hours. Participants supply their perspectives through existing consultation without new structured forms.

Missing baselines, goals or consent details require manual clarification before drafting. Source-pack preparation remains in s1, draft correction21 hours and final participant review20 hours remain counted.
Test native record fields and templates first; use only a permitted pupil-data environment. Required participant approvals follow local procedure and are not replaced by teacher approval.
unknowns: Local program format and review responsibilities
research_questions: Does a complete-program trial preserve every agreed goal and support after all corrections and consultation are timed?

already_counted.description: Assess needs, consult and capture agreed decisions
Check meaning and correct the draft

incremental.description: Maintain program structure and review drafting errors
Maintain access and approved record configuration

approvals.approved_version: Exact student program, goals, supports, source evidence and review dates; edits require renewed teacher and relevant participant review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R86 gross14 minus4 upkeep =10 net E1. High needs settled decisions and repeated prose assembly; low assumes complex corrections remove gross gain while upkeep remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Establish behavior rules and procedures suited to student needs
Enforce rules and maintain order through appropriate responses to students

tasks.design: Retain explanation and enforcement of classroom expectations with the teacher. Existing policies in {DOCS} support the work; no automated behaviour inference or discipline is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Classroom responses depend on student needs and immediate context.
tasks.still_hard: Responding consistently while adapting to individual communication and support needs.
tasks.human_edge: Build trust and choose a suitable response in the moment.

reach.learn: Agreed response strategies and communication needs

evidence.claim: Classroom expectation-setting and enforcement remain fully counted personal work.

assumptions: Boundary is classroom management, excluding separate program documentation and instructional preparation.
Teacher observes behaviour directly during s2 and adapts expectations during s1; no coded behaviour, inferred emotion or ready-made incident flag is assumed.
No new configuration or incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Student communication needs and school procedures
research_questions: Which classroom expectations require adaptation for individual access needs?

already_counted.description: Explain expectations and maintain classroom order

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 upkeep0 net0; direct classroom management remains.

tasks.short: Develop and implement disability support strategies

steps.what: Develop strategies to meet students' individual disability-related needs
Implement and adjust strategies in response to students' needs

tasks.design: Keep support-strategy selection and implementation with the teacher, drawing on agreed plans in {DOCS}. No automatic disability classification or strategy prescription is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Effective strategies depend on the actual student and learning situation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing plans and specialist guidance support the unchanged work.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising whether an adaptation is helping and when further advice is needed.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt support sensitively and observe the student's response.

reach.task: Advise on access and learning adaptations
reach.learn: Individual access needs and observation methods

evidence.claim: Disability-support strategy judgement and implementation remain fully counted human work.

assumptions: Boundary is strategy selection and implementation, excluding the separate writing of the formal education program. If the same planning action serves both tasks, allocate it once.
Teacher produces observations and establishes practical needs during retained work; no structured disability-to-strategy mapping is assumed.
Existing program and specialist advice remain source material. No new software or upkeep.
unknowns: Student access needs and available specialist support
research_questions: What direct evidence would show that a selected adaptation helps this student?

already_counted.description: Select, implement and adapt support strategies

steps.what: Instruct students in daily living skills including hygiene, safety and food preparation

tasks.design: Retain direct demonstration, guided practice and feedback. Existing teaching resources in {DOCS} may support the lesson, with no reduction in personal instruction time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Independent living skills develop through supported practice.
tasks.enabler_now: No new technology is required for the retained instruction.
tasks.still_hard: Adapting pace and support while maintaining safe practice.
tasks.human_edge: Notice understanding and provide the right amount of assistance.
tasks.altitude: Daily living instruction time remains unchanged.

reach.learn: Accessible daily-living practice and support boundaries

evidence.claim: Direct daily-living instruction and practice remain fully counted.

assumptions: Boundary is direct instruction, excluding separately counted lesson preparation and formal program writing.
Teacher observes skill and support needs during the retained lesson; no structured competence flag or automated assessment is assumed.
No new system configuration or incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Learning needs, facilities and support arrangements
research_questions: Which practice activities allow the student to demonstrate increasing independence?
